## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Separately run `prod-db-credential-rotation`, in order, one at a time: availability check; record old lease; mint replacement; update `prod-db-credential`; restart `deployment/orders-api` in `production`; verify startup; revoke old lease; remove `/run/orders-new.json` and `/run/orders-old-lease`.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Always use db-stg-2; db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica and `config/staging.yaml` is stale.

Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination work was superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Staging DB: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded. `InvoicePage` has `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invoice covering index `(customer_id, created_at)`: doubled ingest write latency.

## Recent work
Pagination implementation and tests pass but remain uncommitted. Credential rotation reached replacement minting. Invoice-report profiling found 2,417 SQL statements and N+1 queries; this is unrelated to the current webhook goal.
